trigger: GitHub no longer served the exact benchmark commit, and the EnvBench Hugging Face fallback did not produce a repository result.

recovery.source: A Git-clean historical construction workspace for the same public Dev case and exact revision.
recovery.content: Git source objects only. No historical bootstrap program, trajectory, model output, replay feedback, or evaluator result was copied into the new C0 session or candidate environment.
recovery.official_path: The exact checkout was preseeded into operation.dirs.repo_data. The unmodified EnvBench RepoDownloader then reset, cleaned, and checked out the requested revision before invoking the unmodified container evaluator.

safeguard_note: This enables an existing exact-revision source-cache input on the remote candidate CLI. It adds no runtime gate, hash requirement, or solver rule.
